name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.24
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.24）

这一版给更多拦截页加了放松入口，慢呼吸可以定时停止，续时间时改成点选原因。

**拦截页的放松入口**
- 自律时段、一键专注、完全锁定、今日时长用完、单次上限、打开次数用完和「打开前停一下」这些拦截页，加了「刷手机，不如来放松一会儿」，可以直接去听助眠音或做慢呼吸。放松页里没有回到被拦 App 的入口。
- 在「打开前停一下」页点放松，这次打开就算放弃了，不放行，也不算一次打开。之后再打开要从头等。
- 先学后玩、短视频时间用完和网址拦截的页面不显示这个入口。夜里开了助眠入口的时段，仍显示原来的「睡不着？」卡片。
- 修了一个问题：从最近任务切回被拦的 App 时，「打开前停一下」页有时停在「页面已更新」。现在会从头再等一次。

**慢呼吸**
- 新增「定时停止」，可以选 3、5、10、15、30 分钟。
- 练完或点「结束」后，背景音会很快淡出停下。
- 颂钵在吸气、屏息、呼气时音高不同。风铃换成了更低更柔的木风铃。

**写原因和计划**
- 视频号这类内容时间用完后续时间，或者输解锁码时，点选一个原因就行，也可以自己写，不再要求写满 10 个字。能续多少时间、严格模式的规则都没变。
- 可以顺手定个计划，到点会发一条提醒。提醒只是一条通知，不会多给时间。
- 设置里新增「我的原因和计划」，可以回看最近 7 天的原因分布、集中在哪个时段和自己写过的话。这些只存在手机上，可以一键清除。

**工作软件 HanTalk**
- HanTalk（包名 com.hanmaker.bryan.hc）现在和电话、设置一样算系统必需。任何规则都不拦它，也不计入整台手机的连续使用。
- 这是写在应用里的固定名单，对所有安装涟漪的手机都生效，应用里不能关。

**已知限制**
- 拦截页的放松卡片只在「打开前停一下」页上用真机看过。自律时段、一键专注、完全锁定、时长用完、单次上限和次数用完这几种页面，还没有在真机上看过。
- 「时间到了」页和解锁码页这一版没有在真机上看过。
- 「我的原因和计划」在真机上只看过还没有记录时的样子。
- 部分手机打开受限 App 时，仍可能短暂露出一瞬。
- iPhone 版没有更新，仍是 v0.1.5。

---

This release adds a relax entry to more block screens, lets slow breathing stop on a timer, and lets you pick a reason when you ask for more time.

**Relax from block screens**
- Block screens for schedules, Quick Focus, Complete Lock, daily limit reached, session cap, opens used up and "Wait a moment" now offer "Put the phone down and relax for a bit", with "Sleep sounds" and "Breathe". The relax page has no way back to the blocked app.
- Tapping relax on the "Wait a moment" screen gives up this open. The app is not let through and the open is not counted. Opening it again starts the wait from the beginning.
- Screens for apps set to "Open After Limit", screens shown when short video time runs out, and blocked website screens do not show this entry. Night schedules with the sleep entry turned on keep the "Can't sleep? Play a sleep sound" card.
- Fixed: when you switched back to a blocked app from Recents, the "Wait a moment" screen sometimes got stuck on "This page is no longer current". It now starts the wait again.

**Slow breathing**
- New "Stop after" timer: 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes.
- The background sound now fades out and stops soon after you finish or tap "End".
- The singing bowl has a different pitch for breathing in, holding and breathing out. The wind chimes are replaced with softer, lower wooden chimes.

**Reasons and plans**
- When your time for content such as Channels runs out and you ask for more, or when you enter the unlock code, you can tap a reason or write your own. The 10 character minimum is gone. How much extra time you get and how strict mode works are unchanged.
- You can add a plan, and Ripple sends a reminder when it is due. The reminder is only a notification and gives no extra time.
- Settings has a new "My reasons and plans" page with the last 7 days of reasons, the busiest hours and what you wrote. It stays on this phone and can be cleared in one tap.

**HanTalk for work**
- HanTalk (package com.hanmaker.bryan.hc) is now treated like the phone and settings apps as a system essential. No rule blocks it and it does not count toward whole phone usage.
- This is a fixed list built into the app. It applies to every phone with Ripple installed and cannot be turned off in the app.

**Known limits**
- The relax card has been checked on a real phone only on the "Wait a moment" screen. The schedule, Quick Focus, Complete Lock, daily limit, session cap and opens used up screens have not been checked on a real phone yet.
- The screen shown when in app content time runs out and the unlock code screen were not checked on a real phone for this release.
- "My reasons and plans" was only seen on a real phone with no records yet.
- On some phones, a restricted app may still flash briefly when opened.
- The iPhone app is unchanged and remains v0.1.5.
